loop_primitives.evidence_quote: GA-Rollback utilizes a generator to interact with the environment and an assistant to examine each action produced by the generator, where the assistant triggers a rollback operation upon detection of incorrect actions.
loop_primitives.note: Default: stepwise act loop with assistant review and rollback (generate-verify-repair). multi_attempt reachable via shipped *_reflexion_rollback.py scripts (Reflexion trials).

planning_granularity.note: No plan object; ReAct mode gives free-text thinking.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: --force_same_LM 1 \   # force the generator and assistant to use the same model
multi_agent_topology.note: Generator plus assistant reviewer; per C3 rule a reviewer model is still single. Closest value; arguably pipeline/debate-like.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Particularly, GA-Rollback utilizes a generator to interact with the environment and an assistant to examine each action produced by the generator
delegation_mechanism.note: Assistant only reviews; no subagent spawning.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: we retrieve the action setAt−1 = [a 1,...,a t−1] fromTt−1, reset the environment, and sequentially execute the actions inAt−1 to restore the state to that ofTt−1.
short_term_state.note: Trajectory is the state; past mistakes added to prompt.

long_term_memory.note: Reflexion variant carries reflections across trials within a run; cross-run persistence not shown.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the assistant meticulously examines each action produced by the generator along with the corresponding observation.
self_verification.note: Assistant model call judges each step; default uses same model (force_same_LM 1), so could also be self_critique. Feedback filtered by probability threshold 0.93.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The number of trials for Reflexion is set to 2.
retry_policy.note: Default rollback script single trial; fixed_n (Reflexion trials) reachable via *_reflexion_rollback.py. Stepwise rollbacks capped at max_roll_num 6 are not task-level retries.

rollback.evidence_quote: we retrieve the action setAt−1 = [a 1,...,a t−1] fromTt−1, reset the environment, and sequentially execute the actions inAt−1 to restore the state to that ofTt−1.
rollback.note: Closest value: rollback via environment reset and action replay, not a stored snapshot or git.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: --max_roll_num 6 \    # the maximum num of rollbacks allowed (to prevent infinite loops)
termination_condition.note: max_roll_num caps rollbacks; step caps and task-completion ending inferred, code not in bundle.

execution_isolation.note: Simulated environments (ALFWorld, local WebShop site); no execution-boundary code in bundle.
